LanguageData.QEverything.Presets.Title: Reusable quality presets
LanguageData.QEverything.Presets.Reusable: Presets copy a complete Draft. Saving a preset does not save settings for restart or change the running game.
LanguageData.QEverything.Presets.SaveHint: Enter a new filename. Correct invalid editor inputs before saving. Use Overwrite to replace an existing preset.
LanguageData.QEverything.Presets.OverwriteConfirm: Replace this preset file with the current valid Draft? Its previous snapshot will be lost. The editor Draft stays unchanged.
LanguageData.QEverything.Presets.DeleteConfirm: Delete this reusable preset file? The editor Draft and settings stay unchanged.
LanguageData.QEverything.Presets.Saved: Reusable preset saved. Settings have not been committed for restart.
LanguageData.QEverything.Presets.Failure: Preset operation failed. Check the name, file and folder permissions, then refresh or try another name.
LanguageData.QEverything.Presets.Preview: Review all changed values below. Applying replaces the whole Draft, including rules removed by this snapshot. Undo restores the previous Draft in one step. Saved and Active settings stay unchanged.
